text:
ana: Quick sync: customer wants per-route cost attribution + low-overhead trace hooks so ops can tie SLO blips to dollars. Draft MVP and rollout checks below.

mike: Good ask. Canary thresholds?
sasha: Storage is the leash here. Full traces are expensive. Propose aggressive default sampling + always-on for errors/anomalies.

praveen: Implementation note: sample before any heavy encoding, emit tiny proto envelope to WAL, async uploader. Target <10% CPU overhead on dataplane.

ana: (typo  ana) MVP scope: route token meter, per-model cost multiplier, sampled trace hooks (errors/anomalies + baseline), one dashboard template (route slice + cost + errors), RBAC + CSV export, redaction hooks for Private.

mike: Canary plan: 5% traffic x 48h -> 25% x 72h -> GA. Monitor per-route p50/p95, cost-per-1k, error-rate. Abort if p95 regressions >5% or error uplift >0.3pp or infra spend >18% in canary.

sasha: Retention policy suggestion: full sampled traces 14d, aggregate metrics 90d. Default sampling 0.05% with route overrides. Compression + dedupe required.

praveen: Example sampling config we can expose in Console:
```yaml
sampling:
  default: 0.0005 # 0.05%
  routes:
    "/v1/generate": 0.005
    "/v1/embeddings": 0.0005
  rules:
    on_error: 1.0
    on_cost_anomaly: 1.0
```

joan: Product constraints: RBAC split between billing and eng, export for finance, and PII redaction + KMS tagging for Private. This is a GA blocker for regulated customers. Recommend P0 for next quarter (top-10 customer ask).

observability-bot: opened issue #4788 "console: per-route-cost + sampled-traces MVP" and assigned @ana @praveen @mike. https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/issues/4788

ana: Next steps: Mike -> canary dashboard proto (due Wed); Praveen -> proto envelope + perf sim (due Tue); Sasha -> storage cost calc + retention knobs (due Fri); Joan -> RBAC/export/redaction checklist + customer vignette (due 5 days). Scheduling 30m follow-up after artifacts land. :thumbsup:
